name: ice1-rollout-defense-curl
why: Player Phanpy (set 120) uses Defense Curl first, then keeps choosing Rollout against the opponent's Wobbuffet (set 185): the Defense Curl bit doubles Cmd_rolloutdamagecalculation's dynamic power on every hit of the five-turn lock. No Factory set has both Ice Ball and Defense Curl; Ice Ball and Rollout share the one command.
